timeToFirstTest.text: About 15 minutes in your own workspace

evidence.label: Docs
evidence.note: Estimate: installing to your own workspace needs no review.

timeToProduction.text: Immediate with public distribution. Marketplace listing takes up to 10 business days (preliminary review) plus up to 10 weeks (functional review).

verdict.summary: It works in your workspace right away, and public distribution lets any workspace install it. The Slack Marketplace is optional, but its review is slow and strict.

callouts.text: You don't need the Marketplace for a 'Connect Slack' button. With public distribution turned on, any workspace can install the app through your OAuth link.
Marketplace review can't be skipped or sped up for a launch date.
One developer reported a Marketplace review that took about 4 months.

evidence.label: Uncertain
evidence.note: Anecdotal. Not in any Slack documentation. Slack's published windows are 10 business days plus up to 10 weeks.

steps.title: Write an app manifest
steps.detail: Define the bot/user scopes, redirect URLs, and features in a manifest (YAML/JSON) so you can recreate the app consistently.

steps.title: Create the app at api.slack.com/apps
steps.detail: Sign in, choose 'From a manifest', and pick your development workspace.

steps.title: Install to your workspace and test
steps.detail: Install the app to your own workspace. You can call the API right away; no review is needed.

steps.title: Implement OAuth v2 install flow
steps.detail: Build the 'Add to Slack' redirect and the callback that exchanges the code at oauth.v2.access. Store tokens per workspace.

steps.title: Enable public distribution
steps.detail: In app settings → Manage Distribution, complete the checklist and turn on public distribution. Other workspaces can't install the app until you do, and the Marketplace requires it.

steps.title: (Optional, Marketplace) Reach 10 active workspaces
steps.detail: The Marketplace requires at least 10 workspaces active in the past 28 days, and the app must be out of private beta.

steps.title: (Optional, Marketplace) Prepare listing assets
steps.detail: Draft a public landing page, a support page (2-business-day response target), a privacy policy covering data collection, retention and deletion, 1600×1000 images, and a justification for each scope.

steps.title: (Optional, Marketplace) Record demo video and provide test credentials
steps.detail: Show install, OAuth, setup, end-to-end use, and uninstall. Provide test credentials for your service; Slack doesn't accept Slack workspace credentials.

steps.title: (Optional, Marketplace) Submit and wait
steps.detail: Preliminary review takes up to 10 business days. Functional review takes up to 10 weeks for new apps.

triggerReview.why: Reviewers check the reason you give for each scope. Request scopes only for features that already exist, not planned ones.

triggerReview.scope: Legacy / restricted scopes, broad workspace-data scopes

noReview.why: Installing in your own workspace or through public distribution has no review.

scopes.tip: Start with a narrow bot scope set (e.g. chat:write, channels:read). Add scopes only when you ship the feature that needs them, so Marketplace reviewers can see each one being used.

blockers.reason: Submission not ready (private beta, untested, under construction)
blockers.fix: Submit only after end-to-end testing on a non-development workspace, including uninstall.
Grow installs through public distribution before you apply.
Write a specific, feature-linked reason for every scope, and drop any you don't use yet.

blockers.reason: Install or OAuth fails during the preliminary check
blockers.fix: Test the full install from a fresh workspace using the exact link you submit.

blockers.reason: Returned in preliminary review, which resets your queue position
blockers.fix: Each resubmission at the preliminary stage resets your place in the queue. Complete every item before the first submit. Once a functional reviewer is assigned, resubmitting doesn't reset your place.

blockers.reason: Missing listing info or low-quality images
blockers.fix: Check every listing field and image spec before submitting.

scopeAdvisor.need: Just a 'Connect Slack' button, no Marketplace
scopeAdvisor.why: With public distribution on, any workspace can install through your OAuth link. Scopes are only reviewed for the Marketplace.

scopeAdvisor.use: Only scopes for features that already exist
scopeAdvisor.insteadOf: Scopes for planned features, legacy or broad workspace-data scopes
scopeAdvisor.why: Reviewers check each scope's reason; legacy, restricted and broad workspace-data scopes aren't accepted.
